proposed.name: rank-at-most-three ambient compression
proposed.construction: Choose \(q\geq1\), \(1\leq k\leq\min(q,3)\), and full-row-rank \(B\in\mathbb R^{k\times q}\). For a polynomial \(\bar D\) on \(\operatorname{Sym}_k(\mathbb R)\), set \(D_B(A)=\bar D(BAB^{\top})\) on \(Sq\). Set \(R_k=(I_k\;0)\in\mathbb Q^{k\times3}\) and \(\widetilde D(X)=\bar D(R_kXR_k^{\top})\) on \(S3\).

proposed_core_edits.reason: This construction names the supplied ambient denominator and its canonical three-dimensional recognition input.

proposed.comparator_claim: Vanishing of a coordinate-Hessian determinant need not force a hypersurface to be a cone in the relevant ambient dimensions.
Low-dimensional cubic hypersurfaces with vanishing coordinate Hessian include noncone geometries.
A polynomial direction field satisfying its Jacobian-annihilation condition generates an exact quasi-translation.
The half-trek criterion establishes generic identifiability and yields rational recovery in linear structural equation models.
Computer algebra can certify identification of causal effects in polynomially parametrized models.
Fraction-free elimination performs exact determinant and linear-system calculations over integral domains.
Generalized power functions on symmetric cones are products of powers of principal minors relative to a supplied Jordan frame.
Homogeneous matrix cones admit recursive triangular structures induced by cone automorphisms.

proposed.statement: For a polynomial \(D\) satisfying Assumptions \(\mathrm{ass{:}d\text{-}nonzero}\), \(\mathrm{ass{:}d\text{-}nonconstant}\), and \(\mathrm{ass{:}d\text{-}homogeneous}\), the identity \(2\operatorname{tr}\{(G_D(X)X)^2\}=cD(X)^2\) holds on \(S3\) if and only if there exist \(V1\subset V2\), \(a,b,e\in\mathbb Z_{\geq0}\) with \(a+b+e>0\), and \(\lambda_0\neq0\) such that \(D=D_{\mathrm{flag}}\). In that representation, \(c=2\{(a+b+e)^2+(b+e)^2+e^2\}\), and every active flag subspace is unique.
proposed.justification: This degree-unrestricted converse is the algebraic engine for auditing every supplied denominator whose effective covariance support has dimension at most three.
proposed.gap: Tamano's Theorem 1 proves flag sufficiency, while Theorem 3 supplies determinant stripping, spectral reduction, and the pure branches; Theorem 3 and Remark 4 leave the mixed kernel line open, and the mixed-residue bridge together with positive-gradient kernel rigidity closes exactly that branch.
proposed.consumer: The ambient audit applies this converse to the canonical three-dimensional padding of a rank-at-most-three compressed denominator.

proposed.statement: For a finite rational coefficient encoding \(D\in\mathbb Q[S3]\), the procedure \(\mathcal A_D\) terminates and accepts exactly when \(D\in\mathcal D_{\mathrm{SN},3}\). It rejects before forming \(J_D\) whenever \(D(I3)=0\). On acceptance, the ordered eigenvalues of \(J_D\) are \(a+b+e,b+e,e\), and \(CertD\) contains rational bases for the active spaces, the exponents, \(\lambda_0\), \(c\), and a zero coefficient residual. On rejection, \(CertD\) contains an exact failed guard, a forced nonpositive constant, or a nonzero residual coefficient. No bit-complexity bound is claimed.
proposed.justification: The finite exact-input contract turns the \(\operatorname{Sym}_3\) classification into an auditable recognition and flag-recovery certificate, including for canonically padded compressed denominators.
proposed.gap: Tamano's factor-and-rank diagnostic is inconclusive for determinant-free irreducible factors of degree at least three; exact-algebra sources supply operations but no exhaustive self-normalization classifier.
proposed.consumer: A symbolic causal-identification pipeline applies the recognizer to \(\widetilde D\) and pulls its rational active flag back through the supplied ambient compression without altering the primitive reduced fraction.

prose_updates.tldr: The field-tier contribution is a complete denominator audit for primitive coprime reduced rational causal certificates in arbitrary observed dimension whose denominator is supplied through at most three fixed covariance directions. Tamano's exact ambient-compression invariance transfers the problem, its self-normalization constant, and its Gaussian denominator pivot to the compressed covariance. Canonical padding then lets the unrestricted \(\operatorname{Sym}_3\) converse and terminating rational recognizer decide the compressed polynomial exactly. The algebraic engine is the degree-unrestricted closure of Tamano's mixed branch via positive-gradient kernel rigidity. The resulting confidence set targets only \(D_B(\Sigma_q)\); no inference for the causal ratio, full higher-dimensional converse, software implementation, or bit-complexity theorem is claimed.

project_justification.gap: Tamano leaves the arbitrary-degree mixed rank-two kernel line unresolved in \(\operatorname{Sym}_3\), and a rational causal certificate observed in many coordinates may depend on only a supplied low-rank covariance compression. Prior framing did not expose how the completed three-dimensional converse yields an exhaustive arbitrary-ambient audit while preserving the denominator-only scope.
project_justification.niche: The algebraic classification is performed only on the effective compressed symmetric space. Tamano's exact compression invariance carries the constant and Gaussian pivot between ambient and compressed coordinates, while canonical zero-padding reduces effective dimensions one and two to the same exact three-dimensional recognizer.
project_justification.fill: Positive-gradient rigidity closes the unrestricted mixed \(\operatorname{Sym}_3\) branch. The complete converse and exact rational recognizer, combined with the cited compression transfer, certify every supplied primitive denominator supported on at most three fixed directions in arbitrary observed dimension and return its flag, exponents, scale, constant, residual, and denominator-only confidence set.

sampling_model.design: Known-zero-mean Gaussian covariance sampling \(Z_1,\ldots,Z_n\stackrel{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}N_q(0,\Sigma_q)\) in arbitrary observed dimension. Only \(\widehat\Omega=B\widehat\Sigma_qB^{\top}\), of dimension \(k\leq3\), enters the inherited Wishart pivot; the ambient sample covariance may be singular.
sampling_model.units: The observations are independent vectors in \(\mathbb R^q\). The supplied full-row-rank matrix \(B\) fixes at most three directions. Tamano's three-node front-door example remains only a cited benchmark obtained when the relevant coordinates are \((A,M,Y)\).
sampling_model.overlap: No treatment-overlap condition enters the algebraic theorem. The sampling parameter satisfies \(\Sigma_q\succ0\), and full row rank of \(B\) then implies the compressed covariance \(\Omega=B\Sigma_qB^{\top}\succ0\).
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The classification, canonical padding, and rational recognizer are exact algebraic operations on the supplied compression representation. Sampling is used only for Tamano's inherited pivot and the confidence set for \(D_B(\Sigma_q)\); no inference for \(N_B(\Sigma_q)/D_B(\Sigma_q)\) is asserted.

prose_updates.related_work: Tamano's Theorem 1 \cite{Tamano2026SelfNormalizing} proves flag-power sufficiency, exact invariance of self-normalization and its constant under full-row-rank ambient compression, and the associated Gaussian flag-power pivot. Theorem 3 proves the three-variable determinant stripping, spectral reduction, and pure branches, while Remark 4 isolates constancy of the mixed kernel line as the missing step. The present \(\operatorname{Sym}_3\) theorem closes that branch without degree or nonresonance restrictions; canonical padding and Tamano's compression result then extend the audit, but not the algebraic converse itself, to arbitrary observed dimension with supplied support on at most three fixed directions. The dimension-free rigidity theorem additionally settles every positive-gradient corank-one branch, without settling higher-corank branches or a full all-dimensional converse. Tamano's Example 2 remains the cited three-node front-door benchmark, with its reduced form, covariance functional, denominator identity, and pivot; those benchmark identities are not new claims. Foygel--Draisma--Drton \cite{FoygelDraismaDrton2012HalfTrek} supplies a named family of rational linear-Gaussian causal certificates to which the primitive denominator audit applies. García-Puente--Spielvogel--Sullivant \cite{GarciaPuenteSpielvogelSullivant2010ComputerAlgebra} motivates exact certificate-producing causal algebra, and Bareiss \cite{Bareiss1968SylvesterIdentity} supplies exact elimination operations. De Bondt \cite{DeBondt2017QuasiTranslations} informs only the finite translation mechanism. Ciliberto--Russo--Simis \cite{CilibertoRussoSimis2008Homaloidal} and Gondim--Russo \cite{GondimRusso2015CubicHessian} study coordinate Hessians rather than the trace-pairing matrix gradient used here. Faraut--Korányi \cite{FarautKoranyi1994SymmetricCones} contextualize nested determinant powers, and Tunçel--Vandenberghe \cite{TuncelVandenberghe2023HomogeneousCones} derive recursive structures from cone automorphisms rather than from self-normalization alone.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The new results are dimension-free adjugate-translation invariance, all-dimensional positive-gradient corank-one kernel rigidity, its \(\operatorname{Sym}_3\) specialization, the mixed-residue bridge, the unrestricted \(\operatorname{Sym}_3\) converse, canonical padding for effective dimensions at most three, the rational recognizer, and the resulting arbitrary-ambient audit for a supplied fixed compression of rank at most three. Tamano's flag sufficiency, determinant and spectral reductions, exact ambient-compression invariance, Gaussian pivot, and front-door benchmark are cited background. The ambient extension assumes that \(B\) and \(\bar D\) are supplied; it does not discover an unknown compression. Rational recognition requires rational \(B\) and \(\bar D\) for the exact ambient certificate. The higher-corank all-dimensional branch remains open. The confidence set concerns only \(D_B(\Sigma_q)\): no interval, efficiency statement, limit law, or coverage theorem for the causal ratio \(\tau_B\) follows without joint numerator analysis. No software integration, bit-complexity bound, or non-Gaussian inference is claimed.
